north.scope: 36 hand/wrist/forearm review crops only; compose only over a compatible modular body; do not enable partial recolor on a baked full actor

south.scope: 40 body/grip masks preserving rendered approved scope; head, alternate hair, eye styling, other clothing excluded

recordPolicy.equipmentAndHeadShapes: No inferred equipment contract, production enablement, helmet/hair/eyes, or separability on baked backing. Runtime must validate the existing source registration and preserve other appearance/equipment slots.
recordPolicy.northActivation: REQUIRES_MODULAR_BODY; otherwise data/source only. The crop is valid for local view, but overlaying on an unchanged full body would visibly recreate a patch. Full body diagnostic proof is source-only.

skinMaskEncoding.native-binned-v1: PNG red 1–5 selects native palette tone; red 0 untouched
skinMaskEncoding.continuous-v3: PNG red 255=owned; source luminance interpolated at [33,70,112,157,202,240] across 5 native RGB skin stops plus brighten last RGB by [35,26,16] (clamp each channel), nearest-integer output. Original bypasses all.
